expectations.evidence: setTheme shown, but toggles using 'theme' not 'resolved' — would fail when theme is 'system'

expectations.text: Mentions resolved property or data-theme attribute

notes: Technically passes all assertions but has a subtle bug: toggle uses `theme === 'dark'` instead of `resolved === 'dark'`, which would fail to toggle correctly when theme is set to 'system'. The skill's example uses resolved correctly.
